description:
Required step before mailing postcards. Renders the postcard with the first recipient's real data, checks which owners have mailing addresses, estimates the cost from the user's plan, and returns a confirmation_token.

Show the preview, then ask the user to approve. Only after they approve, call spur_send_postcards with the token (the widget's Send button does the same). The token expires in 30 minutes and only covers this exact template, recipient set, return address and size.

return_address_id.description: Defaults to the user's default return address

template_id.description: Postcard template id (UUID from a Spur list/search tool)

name: spur_preview_postcard_campaign
title: Preview postcard mailing
